description:
Constant touring artist Felo Le Tee has a great work life balance. He considers touring work and being in studio is what he calls "life". With over 50 gigs this year he proofed to work hard. 

His workflow is a pure musical firework and reflects his life moments, spending quality time in the studio and creating great music.
Loaded with catchy Bass-Lines (Log Drums) this EP has it all.

If you're still looking for a special bass OF AmaPiano tracks to spice up your DJ-sets or playlists don't look any further and give this Contagious EP a shot

The mother land breaths his spiritual groovy and rhythmic music that travels through out the globe, calling everyone to gather around for a musical celebration that will heal the pain and sorrow from the human body and drive more joy to the veins of the flash. From the land of the soulful Djoon in Paris to the electrifying land of Flash Factory in New York to the lands of the native brothers and sisters that feel the groovy deep within their souls that transcends to the highly appreciated land of London where all music paramours enjoy every single inch of the beat that drives them to the land of happiness, fast forwarding them to the land Greece were music takes a real turn of culture and soul that just heals the atmosphere and the moment. Tomorrow is a new day and his music returns to the mother land and touches the Pretoria land at the infamous Industrial Shisanyama where the heart beat of house music drives the city and reunites the people while they travel together holding music gently in their hands to TOPFLO Prestige, House 22, Tembisa’s White House, Soweto’s Zone 6 and the infamous Joes Butcher.

Tsholofelo Machine, know as Felo Le Tee is the musical genius of the land echoes out hard work, originality and cultural music authenticity to the world were he preaches the house music bible. Born and raised in Siyabuswa, Mpumalanga, South Africa, Felo Le Tee embarked on his musical career at the age of 14 starting out with a collection of cassettes playing on both side with the other on on cue. With the discovery of computers he than elevated his knowledge to digital DJing which was a very big thing at that time before he could dwell in to vynals. One of his DJ mentors Thobejan, introduced him to Vynals and then from there he went on to CDJs which is the current generation. He always had the passion for furthering his music career and “doing things differently” as he would always proclaim and with his drive and passion to be unique, he met his production mentor Tshegofatso Teffo who introduced him to the musical production side of things.

Felo Le Tee taught him self most of the things that related to music production and disc jockey to a point that he got discovered by a lot of people and became the peoples favourite. He wanted to elevate his career so he made it open himself to further his studies and move to city of love, Tshwane, Pretoria, South Africa were he studied and completed her studies on Sound Technology in Damelin. It was more about the music than the technical side for him so after he completed his studies he continued his music production and released a young demo entitled “Home Land” which got the attention from artist he admired to work with. A song titled “Excitement” from the demo album “Home Land” grabbed DJ Tira’s attention and he requested it to be released under DJ Cndo’s prestigious album titled “Finest Lady Volume 5” under vigorous record label Afrotainment. He than released most of his work on Traxsource from the demo album and other separate songs. He has worked with the infamous Oscar P on a few projects and the US based Nylon Trax family, James Nylon..

Happy new year from our HQ to you and all of your loved ones
